guide.title: Game guide

rules.title: Skill rules
rules.level: Each level-up, pick 1 of {choices} cards — picking a skill you own raises it by 1 (Lv{max} is MAX)
rules.evo: Active at Lv{active} (MAX) + its paired passive at Lv{passive}+ → a ⭐ evolution card appears in slot 1 on the next level-up

synergy.title: Element combos
synergy.burnExplosion: 🔥 Burning enemy + 💥 explosion → the burn spreads to nearby enemies
synergy.pullAoe: 🕳️ Enemy being pulled + area attack → ×1.5 damage
synergy.markPierce: 🎯 Marked enemy + piercing attack → guaranteed critical hit

guide.activeSub: Attack skills that fire automatically — each level adds +25% damage and -8% cooldown
guide.passiveSub: Stat boosts — the listed effect is per level. ⭐ marks evolution ingredients
guide.evolutionSub: Powered-up forms unlocked by a MAX active + its paired passive
guide.mobsIntro: Each stage unlocks one new shape, and earlier shapes keep mixing in. Stages without a boss end after {sec}s, and every stage gives monsters +{hp}% HP and +{atk}% attack.
guide.flowNote: Stage 14 is an all-out assault with every shape and no boss ({allOut}s). Beat the Pentadecagon at stage 15 to enter endless mode — it returns every {every} stages after that.

mob.tri: The most basic mob. Your starter skill kills it in one hit.
mob.square: Twice as tough as a triangle, but slow.
mob.circle: A fast chaser. HP between a triangle and a square.
mob.penta: Draws a warning line for {windup}s, then charges (CD {cd}s). The charge smashes obstacles and deals {dmg} damage on contact.
mob.hepta: Fires slowing shots in four directions every {cd}s. A hit slows you to ×{mult} for {sec}s.
mob.octa: A tank twice as tough as a square. Slow but hard to kill.
mob.deca: Twice as fast as a circle. Very low HP — kill it before it reaches you.
mob.hendeca: Keeps its distance and summons {n} triangles, squares or circles every {cd}s. Take it out first.
mob.dodeca: Slow and weak, but every hit hurts a lot. Never take it head-on.
mob.tetradeca: The toughest and slowest. Regenerates {pct}% of its max HP every second (green ring).

guide.bossesIntro: Boss stages end only when the boss is defeated. Lethal attacks are always telegraphed by warning circles or lines first — and the ❤️‍🩹 revive passive works even against instant kills (except the Final Judgement). Defeating a boss pulls in all XP on screen.

laser.name: Vertex lasers
laser.text: Fires lasers outward from all 6 vertices after a {warn}s warning line. Below half HP it fires a second, offset set.

bomb.name: Lethal bombardment
bomb.text: {bombs} red warning circles (one always under you) explode after {bombWarn}s. A hit is an instant kill! Below half HP there are more.

eat.name: Devour
eat.text: Pulls in nearby monsters and eats them to grow (max HP up to ×{cap}). When the devour gauge fills it bursts with {bullets} bullets. Hitting it drains the gauge.

armor.name: Armor · weak point
armor.text: Invulnerable below {armor}% HP. Only attacks from the yellow vertex get through. The weak point moves every {move}s, so circle the boss.

buff.name: Empower
buff.text: Every {buffCd}s, nearby monsters get ×{buffHp} HP and ×{buffDmg} attack (purple outline).

shot.name: Scaling shots
shot.text: A {spread}-way spread every {shotCd}s. The more HP the boss has, the bigger and stronger the bullets.

arena.name: Colosseum
arena.text: On arrival it builds a colosseum and wipes out every other monster. Standing outside the edge deals damage that keeps growing.

dash.name: Triple charge
dash.text: Every {dashCd}s it charges: straight → horizontal + vertical → horizontal + vertical + diagonals. Each path is shown {dashWarn}s before the charge.

laser.name: 4-way lasers
laser.text: Every {laserCd}s, four lasers drop in behind narrowing warning lines. They leave 🔴 instant-kill tiles and 🔵 slowing tiles for {tile}s.

doom.name: Collapse
doom.text: {doomCount} times below {doom}% HP, the boss splits apart and you must leave the colosseum within {doomWarn}s to survive.

near.name: Close-range penalty
near.text: The longer you stay within {nearR}px of the boss, the slower you get (down to ×{nearMin}). Fight from range.

hole.name: Black hole
hole.text: After a {holeWarn}s warning, it pulls you in every {holeEvery}s for {holeLife}s. Stand on a green safe tile to hold on.

slow.name: Tagger
slow.text: Extremely fast, but every hit slows it down. Keep hitting it to pin it in place.

time.name: Time limit
time.text: Defeat it within {limit} min (+{step} min each time it returns). The longer the fight, the more HP, attack, speed and pattern frequency it gains.

rewind.name: Rewind
rewind.text: Once, below {rewind}% HP, it rewinds to its HP from {back}s ago.

homing.name: Time seekers
homing.text: {homingN} shots every {homingCd}s. They speed up as they get closer and explode after {homingLife}s.

rain.name: Time barrage
rain.text: Warning circles fall, including under you. Over time the warnings get shorter and the circles more numerous.

bombs.name: Time bombs
bombs.text: Every {bombEvery}s, {bombN} bombs orbit the boss. Fail to destroy them within {fuse}s and you lose half your current HP.

clones.name: Time clones
clones.text: {cloneN} clones appear. They are weak but hit extremely hard. They self-destruct after {cloneLife}s, and the real one swaps places too.

rage.name: Time rage
rage.text: A gauge rises over time and makes newly spawned monsters stronger. Collecting XP lowers it.

clock.name: Clock of time
clock.text: Below {clock}% HP, attacks only land from the 12 and 6 o’clock directions ({clockOn}s on / {clockOff}s off).

stop.name: Time stop
stop.text: Every {stopCd}s, the boss, monsters and bullets freeze for {stopSec}s (you can still move). When time resumes: a barrage around you, faster bullets and charging monsters!

reverse.name: Time reversal
reverse.text: At {reverse}% HP, recently killed monsters, broken obstacles and barrages come back. Your level and skills stay.

judgement.name: Final Judgement
judgement.text: When the time limit runs out, the screen turns black and white, and after {judge}s the second hand reaches 12: instant death. Revives cannot stop it.

menu.tagline: An endless puzzle duel — the AI grows as you do
rules: Move and rotate two-cell blocks. 4+ of one color touching up/down/left/right pop
Blocks above fall into the gap — if they connect again, that's a chain (COMBO). Longer chains score and attack more
Your attack first cancels junk headed your way (red marks above your field); the rest flies to the AI
Gray junk blocks break when a color group pops next to them
The AI watches your chains, attacks and close calls, and evolves LEVEL 1 → 5 → 5+. Stronger AI = bigger score multiplier
Fill up to the ✕ in the middle and it's GAME OVER. Fill the AI's field for a K.O. bonus!
menu.controlsTouch: 📱 Drag = move · Tap = rotate (left half ↺ / right half ↻) · Drag down = soft drop · Flick down = hard drop · Flick up = hold (buttons below work too)
menu.controlsKeys: ⌨️ ← → move · ↓ soft drop · ↑/X rotate · Z rotate back · Space hard drop · C/Shift hold
menu.hint: On PC, press Enter to start

menu.slogan: COOK THE CODE · AVOID THE BUG
menu.tagline: Cook 25 coding dishes against the clock, dodge the bugs and chase a high score
rules: When a customer sits down, an order appears. Pick the plate under the table and stack ingredients in code-ticket order
Ingredients marked 🔪🍳 go to a tool when tapped. When done (✓), tap the tool to put it on the selected plate
Tap a plate showing ▶ again to put it into a tool (finish step) or serve it
Wrong order? Fix it with undo (↩) or clear (🗑). Drag a wrong item out of a tool onto 🗑 to throw it away. Serving a wrong dish is a CompileError!
Never serve a table with a 🐛 bug — the dish is wasted and your combo breaks. Bugs leave soon
Clearing orders raises the STAGE — one new menu per stage, plus more tools and customers. Serve the Full-Stack Course at stage 25 to open ∞ infinite mode
If any customer runs out of patience, it is GAME OVER
